cmdlist.001:
📋 *Basic commands* (1/4)

🛍️ *Product / Catalog*
• `{0}` — naya product
• `{1}` — cost, stock aur category ke saath
• `category banao {3}` — nayi category
• `catalog` — list dekhein
• `edit product: {2} - 2000` — price badlein
• `delete product {2}` — product hatayein
• `stock {2} 20` ya `stock {2} +10` — stock set ya add karein
cmdlist.002:
📋 *Basic commands* (2/4)

👤 *Customer*
• `customer add Sara, Model Town, 03001234567`
• `Sara ka phone 03001234567` / `Sara ka address ...` / `Sara ka city ...` — sahi karein

🧾 *Order*
• `{4}` — seedha likh dein, bot draft banayega (Save ya yes)
• `order for Sara`, phir items bhejein
• `walkin {2} 2` — counter sale, phone nahi chahiye
• `order 12 advance 500` / `order 12 delivery 300` / `edit order 12`
cmdlist.003:
📋 *Basic commands* (3/4)

🚚 *Status aur payment*
• `mark 3 shipped` / `mark 3 delivered` / `mark 3 returned`
• `mark 3 paid` — payment mil gayi
• `cancel 3` — order mansookh karein
• `undo` — aakhri kaam wapas

💰 *Kharcha aur cash*
• `expense 500 packaging` / `expenses today`
• `create discount: EID10 10%`
• `drawer open 5000` / `cash in 200 note`
cmdlist.004:
📋 *Basic commands* (4/4)

📊 *Reports*
• `orders today` · `aaj ka hisaab` · `profit` · `margin` · `monthly net`

ℹ️ *Madad*
• `help` · `menu` · `guide` · `kya karun` — agla qadam
• `commands` — yeh list dobara dekhein
